mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Call of the Void</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been Silenced. It cannot use abilities.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Void Shift Cooldown</titleLeft><mainText>Void Shift is on cooldown. Taking damage from non minions or being crowd controlled resets this cooldown.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malzahar gains @DRPercent@% damage reduction and immunity from <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, lingering for @LingerDuration@ seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects. This effect has a @ShieldCooldown@ second Cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_MalzaharPassive_Tooltip}}

Taking damage will restart the Cooldown.
Damage from minions is not reduced, but it does not trigger or restart the Cooldown.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Void Shift Ending</titleLeft><mainText>Void Shift is falling off.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Void Shift</titleLeft><mainText>Malzahar is immune to crowd control and takes reduced damage. Damage from lane minions is unaffected.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Malefic Visions</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage over time; if the target dies while afflicted, the visions pass on to a nearby enemy unit, and Malzahar gains Mana. Voidlings love to attack units experiencing Malefic Visions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Nether Grasp</titleLeft><mainText>Malzahar is channeling to keep his target suppressed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max @StackCap@).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last @VoidlingDuration@ seconds and deal @VoidlingBonusDamageTooltip@ magic damage each hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Voidlings deal @LaneMinionMod*100@% damage to lane minions affected by Malefic Visions.
Voidlings deal @EpicMonsterMod*100@% damage to epic monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Malefic Visions</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage over time; if the target dies while afflicted, the visions pass on to a nearby enemy unit, and Malzahar gains Mana. Voidlings love to attack units experiencing Malefic Visions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains @ManaRestore@ Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below @MinionExecuteThreshold@ Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Silencing</status> for @SilenceDuration@ second(s).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malzahar <status>Suppresses</status> an enemy champion and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @CCDuration@ seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing <magicDamage>@ZoneDamageTooltip@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoolDuration@ seconds.
